title: mallotus oblongifolius
intro: Mallotus oblongifolius, commonly known as the Riddhi plant, is a species of plant in the family Euphorbiaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine in various parts of Asia. Mallotus oblongifolius is valued for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, are believed to be responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antitumor activities.
